title: uncinia compacta var. divaricata
intro: Uncinia compacta var. divaricata, commonly known as New Zealand hair grass, is a type of flowering plant native to New Zealand. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The bioactive constituents of New Zealand hair grass include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
